findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: The handwashing sink was observed to have several items stored inside the basin, including drink packages, paper towels, and handwashing soap, obstructing its use. The operator requested that the inspector use the three-compartment sink for handwashing; however, the inspector educated the operator on the designated use of each sink. CORRECTED - The items were removed from the handwashing sink, and the sink was made accessible. Ensure the handwashing sink is kept clear of all items and used exclusively for handwashing, and that the three-compartment sink is used only for warewashing.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. [PF]

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: Ice cubes in the ice machine were observed to be contaminated due to mold present on the baffles and inner corner surfaces of the machine. CORRECTED - The inspector instructed the operator to discard the ice due to mold contamination and bare hand contact and the ice cubes were discarded. Ensure the ice machine is properly cleaned and sanitized and maintained free of mold to prevent contamination of ice. The inspector will follow up on April 27, 2026 regarding the ice machine (see Violation #16).
findings.citation_text: 3-101.11 Safe, Unadulterated, and Honestly Presented. FOOD shall be safe, unADULTERATED, and, as specified under § 3-601.12, honestly presented. [P]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment:
The following food-contact surfaces were observed to be in need of cleaning:

1. The ice machine baffle and inner corner surfaces were observed to have mold. 
2. The soda gun and soda holster were observed to have significant soil accumulation.
3. The pizza oven was observed to have food debris accumulation.

The operator was informed and instructed to clean the above-mentioned surfaces and maintain them free of soil and food debris buildup. The operator attempted to clean the soda gun and soda holster during the inspection; however, soil accumulation was still observed. Ensure all food-contact surfaces are properly cleaned and sanitized and maintained free of soil, mold, and food debris. The inspector will follow up on April 27, 2026 to verify compliance.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. [PF]

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Quaternary ammonium (quats) test strips at the facility were observed to be soiled and unusable, and the operator was unable to locate the quats sanitizer tablets. The inspector advised the operator to use the EPA-approved bleach available for sanitizing food-contact surfaces; however, no chlorine (bleach) test strips were available. CORRECTED - The inspector provided chlorine test strips for interim use until new test strips are obtained. Ensure appropriate sanitizer test strips are available, clean, and usable at all times for monitoring sanitizer concentrations. The inspector will follow up on April 27, 2026 to verify compliance.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.116 Warewashing Equipment, Determining Chemical Sanitizer Concentration. Concentration of the SANITIZING solution shall be accurately determined by using a test kit or other device.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned.
findings.comment: An uncovered trash can was observed in the female restroom. CORRECTED - The inspector discussed with the operator the need to provide a covered waste receptacle for sanitary napkins. Ensure a covered trash receptacle is provided and maintained in female restrooms.
findings.citation_text: 5-501.17 Toilet Room Receptacle, Covered. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. [C]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed soda gun to have accumulation of soda syrup on dispensing surface. Soda gun was cleaned during inspection. 

4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. (B) Does not apply to FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS which opens into larger structure. (C) Exterior doors need not be self-closing if designed for limited-use. (D) If opening present, opening shall be protected against rodent and insects. (E) Paragraph (D) not applicable when pests are absent. 
The back door is missing a self closing device. Provide self closing back door before next routine inspection.

findings.title: Garbage & refuse properly disposed; facilities maintained
findings.comment:
5-501.11: An outdoor storage surface for REFUSE, recyclables, and returnables shall be constructed of nonabsorbent material such as concrete or asphalt and shall be SMOOTH, durable, and sloped to drain. 
The dumpster is located on an area with gravel and some grass. Provide a smooth, nonabsorbent area for the dumpster that is in compliance with this part of the code.
